slides.title: Washington calls for calm
slides.body: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio spoke with PM Abiy Ahmed on Oct 14.

slides.title: “Respect the sovereignty”
slides.body: Rubio said countries in the region “must respect the sovereignty and territorial integrity of their neighbors,” AP reported.

slides.title: Back to the 2018 peace deal
slides.body: He urged dialogue under the 2018 Ethiopia–Eritrea peace agreement.

slides.title: Accusations at the UN
slides.body: Ethiopia accuses Eritrea of sending troops across the border. Eritrea calls Ethiopia's stance a “declaration of war.” AP could not verify the claims.

slides.title: Dialogue, not war.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: AP, "Rubio urges restraint over Ethiopia-Eritrea tensions" · Oct 15, 2026
